title: Budgets (budgets.yaml)
description: The scientist's limits. Every rule is a field; comments in the file may give reasons but carry no rules. A resource name matches the key experiments use in cost_estimate / cost_actual, and has one or more limits.

min.description: Never less than this (a floor, such as free disk)

per.description: instant: at any moment; run: one run or job; week: the last 7 days of experiment outcomes; program: all of them. week and program are summed from the ledger by program check; instant and run are the agent's to watch.

where.description: Where the limit applies: local (the computer sessions run on) or a host named in program.toml [hosts]
